sources.fact: Planning Committee agenda/minutes identify Land at Margaret Bondfield Avenue, Barking IG11 9NG and application 20/00040/FUL.
September 2020 minutes describe construction of 15 units for temporary accommodation.
The 15 units are described as temporary accommodation in Sui Generis use.
The proposal included demolition of structures associated with the former garage site.
The minutes record 118 neighbour letters plus site and press notices.
Ten objections and a petition with 71 signatures were recorded.
Two further representations were recorded after report publication.
The same application appeared at Planning Committee on 23 March 2020.
At Be First's request the March 2020 application was withdrawn for future consideration and determination.
Its September return is retained as procedural history and is not treated as proof of a currently extant 2026 permission.
Current Local Plan policy context is kept separate from exact application finality.
A current exact decision/readback is required before treating the historic case as extant permission.

examples.result: 15 temporary units are preserved as the proposal scope and are not converted to general C3 housing capacity.
Former-garage demolition is proposal context, not title evidence.
March withdrawal and September return are kept as separate procedural events.
Neighbour objections do not change the application identity or legal finality.
No 2026 extant-permission conclusion is inferred from the 2020 committee history alone.
No point/address is converted to an HMLR parcel polygon.
Promotion remains zero until current exact decision, title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
